summary: Frontend UI testing of Goorin Linesheet page cohesive chrome + MultiSelect (Seasons/Collections). All requested behaviors verified. Header uses .ops-head with kicker 'Tools', h1 'Linesheet', ls-open-saved and ls-new-top buttons visible. Catalog card head shows 'Catalog · N shown'. Season MultiSelect opens with search, options SS27(26)/FW26(20)/Core(11), SS27 pre-checked. Adding FW26 → '46 products found', toggle shows '2 seasons' with badge 2. Search 'co' filters to Core only. Clear → 'All seasons' + 57 products. Done, Escape, and outside click all close the menu. Collections MultiSelect works identically; selecting Suede+Core with SS27+FW26 → 18 products; button shows '2 collections' with badge. ls-select-page, ls-select-all, ls-clear all work. Card price row shows '$16.00 MSRP $40.00'; ls-toggle-msrp hides the MSRP small element (count 0 after off). Saved draft with SS27+FW26 persisted to backend with season='SS27,FW26' (verified via GET /api/linesheets); the drawer entry shows 'SS27 · FW26'. No console errors observed at 1920x800.
critical_code_review_comments: LinesheetPage.tsx has many extremely long single-line JSX expressions (lines 34, 44, 70, 111, 172, 182, 211) that hurt readability and PR-review quality; consider light formatting or extracting sub-components (price chip, picked-row, saved-row).

In LinesheetPage.open(), season is read from stored string via ls.season.split(',') — works, but consider storing seasons as an array to avoid string-parse coupling and to allow season values that ever contain commas.

MultiSelect close-on-outside relies on mousedown but the toggle button uses onClick; behavior is fine today but a click on the toggle after opening via focus/keyboard could double-toggle in edge cases.
seed_data_creation: One draft TEST_ML_1789602008 created and cleaned up via DELETE /api/linesheets/{id} (HTTP 204).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Linesheet uses hash routing (#linesheet). Sidebar link 'Linesheet' navigates reliably; page.evaluate hash change also works but may need click fallback. MSRP toggle is a hidden checkbox inside label.ls-switch — click the label. Saved drafts stored via REAL /api/linesheets with season as CSV string. When looking up saved rows in drawer, filter data-testid strictly to /^ls-saved-[^-]+$/ to avoid matching ls-saved-drawer/open/dup/link/del elements.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature implementation validated end-to-end without defects.
